title: Loan Program Adjustment on Rate Lock Commitment Float-Down Fees
content:
Government and jumbo programs price a **Rate Lock Commitment** float-down differently. The loan program of the **Mortgage Loan File** adjusts the float-down fee points. The float-down fee points are never below zero and are rounded to three decimal places.

**Rule.**

- A Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed or Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed file subtracts the government-program credit of **0.125** points.
- A Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed file adds the jumbo-program surcharge of **0.125** points.
- Any other program has no adjustment.

| Loan program | Adjustment to the float-down fee points |
|---|---|
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 0.125 subtracted |
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 0.125 subtracted |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 0.125 added |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed, Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | none |
